title: refactor(ci): consolidate release automation and simplify lint/test workflows (deps & hygiene)
author: Alex Morgan
description:
Motivation: Our repo has accumulated multiple release and CI workflow variants across services which increased maintenance burden and caused intermittent cache misses and longer CI runtimes. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a smaller, standardized set, bumps GitHub Actions and Node runner versions where safe, and centralizes common steps into reusable workflow templates.

What this PR does: - Introduces .github/workflows/ci-matrix.yml to unify lint/test matrices for JS/TS SDKs and core services. - Reworks release automation to use a single templated workflow with explicit validation steps and improved changelog generation. - Replaces several ad-hoc scripts with scripts/release/annotate.sh and standardized Makefile.ci targets. - Updates GH Actions to pinned stable versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and consolidates cache key strategy to reduce misses. - Bumps node test matrix to include node 18 and node 20 where supported; falls back to node 18 for legacy packages. - Removes duplicated workflow fragments and dead scripts discovered during cleanup.

Compatibility and risk: No runtime changes to production services. Release workflow behavior preserved; tagging and publish steps unchanged but now routed through a single template so future changes are safer. We ran a dry-run release in the integration playground and validated artifacts.

Notes: This is a hygiene and developer-experience improvement aimed to reduce CI costs and cognitive load for contributors. Follow-up PR will migrate remaining minor repos to the new templates and remove deprecated workflows.

Commits summary: See commits list for per-change granularity.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate workflows and templates
- [x] Bump GH Actions to v4 where compatible
- [x] Add centralized caching strategy and update keys
- [x] Validate release dry-run in integration environment
- [x] Update READMEs and docs for CI contributors

review_comments: Priya Kapoor: Left a couple of comments about cache key entropy - we should include package-lock sha where available to avoid collisions.
Alex Morgan (author): Updated cache-keys.sh to include package lock / yarn.lock hash and added tests for deterministic keys.
Diego Ramirez: Approved after verifying the release-template flow in the integration playground. Noted that the dry-run flag should be explicit in the template invocation.
Hannah Lee: Requested we keep node 14 exit path for legacy internal tooling. I added conditional fallback to node 18 in the matrix for those packages.
Alex Morgan (author): Addressed all review comments; pushed a follow-up commit to document fallback behavior and add a migration note in docs/ci-migration.md.
ci_checks: integration-tests - flaky on first run, restarted and passed
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows and release automation, bumped GH Actions to v4, improved cache key strategy to reduce CI runtime and cache misses. No behavioral changes to published artifacts. Follow-up: migrate remaining repos to templates and remove deprecated workflows.
